chapter.title: Console
chapter.para: JetOS has a main console, a serial line that the kernel and the partitions write their messages to and that the monitor reads its commands from, and a debug console, a second serial line that is used only by the GDB server.

section.para: JetOS shall write the text that a partition sends to the console to the main console, as the partition gave it.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Partitions report their state and their errors on the console.

section.para: JetOS shall not lose the text of a write of a partition to the console, nor mix it with that of another write.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Partitions report their state and their errors on the console.

section.para: JetOS shall provide the kernel with formatted output to the main console, whose text is written as one message, so that the messages of the kernel and of a partition are not interleaved.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Messages that are mixed are unreadable.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: HLR_FORMAT_JET_FORMAT_01 HLR_PRINTF_BUF_FLUSH_01 HLR_PRINTF_INIT_BUFFERED_OUTPUT_01 HLR_PRINTF_BUF_PUTC_01 HLR_PRINTF_CLOSE_BUFFERED_OUTPUT_01 HLR_PRINTF_PRINTF_01

section.para: JetOS shall translate each line feed that it writes to the main console into a carriage return and a line feed.
JetOS shall give the main console and the debug console, on request, the characters that have arrived, without waiting for more.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The monitor and the GDB server read their input this way.

section.para: JetOS shall be able to wait for the next character of the main console and of the debug console.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The monitor and the GDB server read their input this way.

section.para: JetOS shall write to a console all the bytes it is given, waiting for the device as long as it must.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A console must not lose output.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: HLR_CONS_UART_PUTC_01 HLR_CONS_IOSTREAM_WRITE_01 HLR_CONS_IS_TRANSMIT_EMPTY_01 HLR_CONS_WRITE_SERIAL_01 HLR_CONS_IOSTREAM_WRITE_COMMON_01 HLR_CONS_IOSTREAM_WRITE_MAIN_01 HLR_CONS_JET_CONSOLE_WRITE_COMMON_01 HLR_CONS_JET_CONSOLE_WRITE_01 HLR_CONS_JET_CONSOLE_WRITE_DEBUG_01 HLR_CONS_POK_CONS_WRITE_01 HLR_CONS_POK_CONS_WRITE_1_01

section.para: JetOS shall drop what is written to a console that the board does not provide, and give no input from it, instead of failing.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A module can run on a board that has no second serial line.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: HLR_CONS_UART1_PROBE_01 HLR_CONS_DEBUG_WRITE_01 HLR_CONS_DEBUG_READ_01 HLR_CONS_IOSTREAM_INIT_01 HLR_CONS_IOSTREAM_WRITE_NULL_01 HLR_CONS_IOSTREAM_READ_NULL_01 HLR_CONS_IOSTREAM_GET_DEFAULT_01

section.para: JetOS shall pass the data of the debug console to the serial line unchanged.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The protocol of the debugger needs the bytes as they are.
